text:
Travis Konecny missed most of October with an injury, and he came back to a Flyers team with more noise than wins. In Philadelphia's week of ice-time arguments around Matvei Michkov, one clip that made the rounds, per NHL Trade Rumors, showed Konecny calling Michkov out on the bench. Whatever was said, the veteran is part of that story now too.

His own game has been fine without being loud. He has six points in 11 games, including a power-play goal in Vancouver on Nov. 9, on 17 minutes a night. Two goals on 2.7 expected (the quality of his chances) is about right, and the Flyers have scored 2.7 fewer goals than their chances deserved with him on the ice. At five on five they're more than six points better in chance share with him than without.

Our talent range puts his scoring rate above what he's showing, so the points should pick up if his minutes do. Evolving-Hockey flagged his defense last season, with chances against piling up when he was on. Watch both ends.
headline: Konecny is back, in a loud week
